name: F-Web repeating blaster
description: The F-Web repeating blaster was a type of repeating blaster produced by BlasTech Industries. It cost 8,500 credits and was equipped with a small deflector shield generator which could deflect small arms fire, but required a third person to operate. It was the successor to the E-Web heavy repeating blaster cannon. It was not as efficient as the E-Web (15).
